hook.name: Pangea Multichain Hook
hook.description: PangeaFeeHook collects trading fees entirely in the quote asset on every swap by intercepting beforeSwap (exact-in buys, exact-out sells) and afterSwap (exact-in sells, exact-out buys), minting ERC-6909 claims redeemable by a per-pool splitter. Pools must be pre-registered by approved factories with fee 0; swaps that push the price outside the launch range are reverted.
